brief: The founder's productivity stack: 5 tools that buy back 10 hours every week.

slots.desc1: The all-in-one workspace for docs, wikis, and project tracking.
slots.desc2: Open-source scheduling that eliminates email ping-pong completely.
slots.desc3: No-code automation that moves data between your apps silently.
slots.desc4: AI research assistant that drafts, edits, and thinks in seconds.
slots.desc5: Async video messaging that replaces most standups and updates.

slots.toolTagline: Your company brain, from pitch deck to product wiki.
slots.bigStatement: Notion replaces five separate apps so your team always knows what's true.
slots.use1Body: Keep SOPs, roadmaps, and investor updates in one living workspace.
slots.use2Body: Onboard new hires in minutes with searchable, linked knowledge bases.
slots.use3Body: Track deals, hires, and bugs without buying another database tool.

slots.toolTagline: Scheduling infrastructure that puts your calendar on autopilot.
slots.bigStatement: Stop the email tennis; let strangers book time only when you are free.
slots.use1Body: Share one link and let investors, customers, and candidates self-schedule.
slots.use2Body: Distribute sales calls evenly across your crew without manual coordination.
slots.use3Body: Monetize office hours with built-in Stripe collection per booking slot.

slots.toolTagline: The glue that passes data between apps while you sleep.
slots.bigStatement: Automate the busywork that leaks hours between meetings every week.
slots.use1Body: Send form entries from your site straight to Notion, Slack, and CRM.
slots.use2Body: Auto-post new blog updates across LinkedIn, Twitter, and your newsletter.
slots.use3Body: Trigger payment reminders and receipt logging without touching a spreadsheet.

slots.toolTagline: An intern that writes code, copy, and strategy at 3 AM.
slots.bigStatement: Turn a blank page into a first draft in seconds instead of hours.
slots.use1Body: Write investor updates, landing pages, and support replies in your voice.
slots.use2Body: Paste errors and get working fixes without losing context switching tabs.
slots.use3Body: Summarize long reports and compare competitors while you grab coffee.

slots.toolTagline: Record once, share everywhere, and skip the live meeting.
slots.bigStatement: Replace status syncs with async video that your team watches 2x.
slots.use1Body: Walk through metrics and blockers without scheduling another standup call.
slots.use2Body: Capture bugs and UX ideas with narrated screen recordings in one take.
slots.use3Body: Send personalized demos to prospects who aren't ready for a live call yet.

slots.toolTagline: The AI-native editor that writes and refactors code for you.
slots.bigStatement: Ship features 10x faster by pair-programming with an AI that knows your codebase.
slots.use1Body: Paste console errors and get fixed commits without Stack Overflow rabbit holes.
slots.use2Body: Write boilerplate, tests, and API routes with ghost-text suggestions inline.
slots.use3Body: Restructure legacy files or migrate libraries via natural language commands.

slots.body: Set these six tools up once and watch your deep-work time multiply. Start with Notion, then automate the rest.
